lore.summary: The hosts joke that snowy Canadian Christmas is more real than Johnny's warm holiday. This is banter, not a literal cultural ranking.

evidence.quote: Your Christmas is more real than my Christmas

speaker.basis: Named opening and dialogue continuity; no audio or reliable turn labels.

lore.summary: Kat recalls getting N64 one Christmas and the original Mario Party a later Christmas; the recalled hardware year and childhood age are approximate.

evidence.quote: I got the N64 the Christmas after it would have come out

speaker.basis: Named opening and dialogue continuity; no audio or reliable turn labels.

lore.summary: Kat and her cousin stayed up playing Mario Party and making boxed macaroni and cheese; the tradition continued across later Christmases.

evidence.quote: We stayed up all night long. We made craft dinner at two o’clock in the morning

speaker.basis: Named opening and dialogue continuity; no audio or reliable turn labels.

lore.summary: Kat's cousin prefers N64 Mario Party1–3 for nostalgia and will not move to GameCube or a modern installment; a question about Mario Party10 is not evidence of playing it.

evidence.quote: So we stick to the original 1, 2, and 3

speaker.basis: Named opening and dialogue continuity; no audio or reliable turn labels.

evidence.quote: It’s going to be very embarrassing if our math is all wrong there

speaker.basis: Named opening and dialogue continuity; no audio or reliable turn labels.

lore.summary: Johnny is rearranging shelves and planning for current/future box protectors. Both hosts value a precise fit and dislike gaps; reported shelf capacities are not universal storage specifications.

evidence.quote: I have to account for box protectors and like future box protectors

speaker.basis: Named opening and dialogue continuity; no audio or reliable turn labels.

evidence.quote: And then I had one present under the tree. And it was Metroid
